well: GISP2 (Greenland Ice Sheet Project 2) borehole, Summit, Greenland - one of the deep ice-core boreholes; USGS precision temperature log (Clow), the profile whose shape records the last glacial period
operator_on_log: USGS temperature logging (G. D. Clow); GISP2 drilling program
source_database: Greenland and Canadian Arctic ice temperature profiles database (GEUS): Lokkegaard et al. 2023, The Cryosphere 17, 3829-3845, doi:10.5194/tc-17-3829-2023; data DOI 10.22008/FK2/3BVF9V (GEUS Dataverse); redistributed in the public GEUS-Glaciology-and-Climate/greenland_ice_borehole_temperature_profiles GitHub repository (boreholes/GISP2/data.csv)
license: open science database (Copernicus/The Cryosphere CC-BY publication; GEUS Dataverse); attribution to Lokkegaard et al. 2023, Mankoff et al. 2022 (10.22008/FK2/3BVF9V), and the GISP2/USGS measurement lineage (Clow)
fetch_method: read-only HTTPS fetch (text/plain) - the COMPLETE file fit within the fetch window
coverage: COMPLETE FILE: all 598 stations, 72.61-3053.15 m (surface firn to bedrock), verbatim. Transcription integrity: endpoints, row count, the -32.1345 degC minimum at 1495 m, and multiple sampled values are gate-verified; the source URL serves the identical file for independent re-verification.
curves: t (temperature, degC) - CONTINUOUS MEASURED TEMPERATURE, 5 m stations
temperature_data: THE TEMPERATURE-CURVE PRIZE: the catalogue's first continuous MEASURED temperature-vs-depth profile - 598 real stations from -31.41 degC near surface through the -32.13 degC glacial-memory minimum (1495 m) to -9.29 degC at the bed. Exercises the converter's TOP tier (MEASURED_CURVES) with real data for the first time.
dialect_notes: temperature-profile CSV (d,t header) - the catalogue's first non-LAS entry; ingested via read_temperature_csv into a depth-indexed LiveStream with a TEMP channel (DEGC), then las_to_profile hits the MEASURED_CURVES tier (C-to-F conversion branch).
purpose: sixth catalogue entry - the MEASURED_CURVES tier exercised with real data; sixth region (Greenland); ice borehole disclosed as such (pressure conversion remains DERIVED hydrostatic, labeled)
verified: 598 stations; endpoints + minimum verbatim; MEASURED_CURVES derivation with degC->degF conversion; gate-pinned
